about: Expected outcome of the exact-projection check on the shipped synthetic panel tiny_geno.tsv (12 individuals, 24 sites, 276 site pairs; random genotypes and positions, not real data): for n = 4, 6, 8 projected chromosomes (m = 2, 3, 4 individuals; C(12,m) = 66, 220, 495 subsets) the dynamic-programming grid of twosite_projection.project_grid equals the explicit enumeration twosite_projection.brute_grid on every one of the (n+1)^2 cells of every pair (6900, 13524, 22356 cells compared) with exact Fraction equality, and every grid sums to exactly 1. Comparand of the twosite_projection leg; brute_check() returns these fields.
